comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus lift a recessed can tab to break a scored-panel seal.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires two-tool countertorque; the can task requires small-feature pinching, lever motion, and breakaway-force control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades angle retention and repeated operation; the can task grades maximum tab lift, panel opening, hand clearance, and a one-second hold.
comparison.reason: Levering a breakaway seal is unrelated to maintaining and locking an adjustable stop.
